name: Caddy Proxy Manager v1.1.0
body_html:
What's changed

  • 4ba3c36 Round 3 contract: DNS-01, clustering, server telemetry and traffic statistics (Core models/interfaces, SPEC, module scaffolding, web types/hooks/routes)
  • 6978e03 docs: add repo CLAUDE.md with the Windows-only implementation rule
  • c44f145 docs: README features for DNS-01, clustering, server details and traffic; SPEC: Windows-only resource sampling
  • d8a7d2d feat(config): DNS-01 providers, shared storage, traffic statistics log, secret scrubbing and managed-node guards (Round 3)
  • 39b125d feat(telemetry): server telemetry and traffic statistics (IServerTelemetry)
  • a7606f5 feat(cluster): primary/node clustering with encrypted RPC, configuration replication and Servers API
  • 6822da3 feat(web): DNS-01 challenge settings, cluster tab and read-only node mode
  • b73fb34 feat(web): servers, server detail and traffic pages with hand-written SVG charts
  • 98fc918 refactor(telemetry): Windows-only machine CPU/memory and file identity; remove Linux/macOS implementations
  • 7d5f38a Integrate Round 3: fix cluster re-push of a rejected revision and stale node sync error, fingerprint/token time on ServerSummary, settings input strips output-only fields, storage note on certificates; Round 3b contract (DNS challenge delegation)
  • 34ea0cf fix(web): end chart y-axes exactly at a hard maximum (total memory, 100 %)
  • adaafde fix(web): Servers table fits 1440 px (versions and load columns, last seen under status); fixed-width mini meters
  • 2b0c475 feat(config): DNS challenge delegation (CNAME) - per-host delegation fields with validation, DNS policies grouped by delegation name, POST /api/dns/delegation-check (DnsClient.NET), docs; E2E issuance through CNAMEs with a read-only production zone
  • a252eb1 feat(web): DNS challenge delegation (CNAME) UI — settings panel with default delegation name, records table, copy and Check DNS; host editor delegation select and per-host records; mock delegation-check endpoint
  • 738a62b test: telemetry E2E tests run the generated Caddy config; full-stack traffic E2E through the API; cluster E2E asserts strict node guards and the node's real telemetry; require Cluster/Telemetry E2E tests on Windows CI
  • c346800 fix: start every background service (retention, scheduled backups and the stats ingester were dropped by AddHostedService de-duplication); CI downloads the caddy-plugins build for the cluster tests; DNS names wrap at dots; single storage warning on the Cluster tab; SPEC Round 3b details
  • 6099ff1 ci: require the background-services E2E test on Windows
  • bdc4bd3 ci: require the DNS delegation E2E test on Windows
  • b8671e8 core: ISecretScrubber, IConfigMutationLock; CustomAcmeRootPath is node-local; ignore agent worktrees
  • 9155b3d contract: key rotation result and pending flag for cluster nodes
  • 73c49ad fix(config): SEC-1 SEC-4 SEC-5 DNS-1 DNS-2 DNS-3 DNS-4 DNS-5 DLG-1 STO-1 LOG-1 CL-2 (config half)
  • 5891066 fix(telemetry): SEC-2, TEL-1, TEL-2 host keys only for configured names, everything else under (other), key length guarded, failed saves rewind instead of growing; TEL-3 unopenable log path is not a rotation; TEL-4 own telemetry.db, counters every flush and sketches/top clients once a minute with replay after restart, rate-limited report flush; TEL-5 per-interface network deltas; TEL-7 handler failure rewinds the tailer to the line; TEL-8 culture-invariant bucket ids and duplicate-tolerant reports; TEL-9 keyed client hashes with a protected per-install key; TEL-10 Caddyfile mode reports statistics as not collected
  • 3ab3ead fix(cluster): real key rotation (rekey RPC, pending retried on contact) and re-join of a node's own primary; replay protection across node restarts; primary instance pinning; bounded RPC bodies and throttled rejection logging; staged plugin rebuilds with back-off and no false recovery; replication under the config mutation lock and from committed config only; detail query never syncs inline; no alerts for nodes that have not joined; unreadable certificates kept on nodes; custom ACME root replicated as content (SEC-3, SEC-6, SEC-7, CL-1, CL-2, CL-3, CL-4, CL-5, CL-6, CL-7, CL-8, CL-9, CL-10, CL-11, CL-12)
  • 92e3ab3 fix(web): WEB-1..WEB-10, TEL-6 and the UI of SEC-3/CL-8 (key rotation result, join commands); E2E checks of the UI against the mock in headless Chrome
  • c2670a5 Integrate review fixes: (other) traffic in the cluster E2E, rotation/cluster query invalidation, Check DNS defaults to public DNS with a this-server option, single Redis address, (other) host label, re-join form on nodes, SPEC Round 3c, CI requires the new E2E tests
  • 629ce83 fix(web): server management URL wraps at dots
  • 52caf59 refactor: remove macOS/Linux code paths (Caddy platform is always windows/ with the .zip release; .tar.gz uploads are refused; no Unix file modes; non-Windows readiness port checks are Skipped; EphemeralKeySet guarded as Windows-only); Windows readiness test covers stream ports
  • 584f3b6 test: read Caddy's live logs with ReadWrite|Delete sharing (Windows sharing violation)
  • ae45dc1 fix(telemetry): a flush before the first request no longer overflows (DateTime.MinValue - EvictAfter), which failed every save on a server without traffic; test: cluster managers run Caddy as a child process on Windows (not the shared Caddy service); test loggers keep full exceptions for CI diagnosis
  • 3012f24 ci: dispatchable windows-tests workflow (one test project, optional filter); test: write-load artifact lists per-minute requests and unique clients
  • b869fd4 fix(telemetry): telemetry.db uses ordinal (binary) collation — LiteDB takes a new file's collation from the current culture, and under th-TH on Windows ICU bucket ids were not found again by id; test: write-load runs all 8 workers regardless of CPU count (a 4-CPU runner sent to only half the clients)
  • 80064a6 test: the culture test names the hour buckets it found when the lookup misses
  • 21cebee test: telemetry persistence Base reads the clock once (two reads put it before the hour on Windows)
  • 892a85a docs: correct the telemetry collation comment (ordinal is a safeguard; the culture test failure was the test's double clock read)

Downloads

File Use
CaddyProxyManager-1.1.0-x64.msi Windows installer (double-click, or msiexec /i CaddyProxyManager-1.1.0-x64.msi /qn)
CaddyProxyManager-1.1.0-win-x64.zip Zip install: extract, then .\install.ps1 in an elevated PowerShell

After installing, open http://<server>:81/ and paste the setup token from C:\ProgramData\CaddyProxyManager\setup-token.txt.

9feaee67e1e92ef27cddbb179c92f7c0d3322f6f8ae8991ea05a61cd9cdf7eca  CaddyProxyManager-1.1.0-win-x64.zip
df6006f9210d195e96eb7351c925758d5d082672090ca3f5670d510b5e4af462  CaddyProxyManager-1.1.0-x64.msi

name: Caddy Proxy Manager v1.0.2
body_html:
What's changed

  • b046a02 docs: add AGENTS.md rule to check current-version documentation
  • d23a41a docs: remove AGENTS.md (rule lives in the user-level instructions)
  • 75fddf0 fix: forward bodiless HTTP/3 requests to HTTP/2 upstreams with END_STREAM
  • f9d6947 feat: HTTP/3 off by default; readiness treats a missing UDP 443 rule as optional
  • 87cfa2e fix(config): align generated Caddy config with v2.11.4 documented behaviour
  • 7e03305 fix(platform): harden Windows service control and readiness per Windows docs
  • 4c1961e fix(ops): route notifications through the outbound proxy and require TLS for SMTP credentials
  • 715d5f2 ci: test the pinned Caddy, run Windows and HTTP/3 end-to-end suites, and document VM checks
  • 4a83903 fix(platform): start Windows PowerShell without an inherited PowerShell 7 PSModulePath
  • 893d7dc test: choose ports that are also bindable for UDP; accept Windows' reason after the not-exportable guidance
  • 892a91d test(installer): pass an [int] field index to the Windows Installer COM record
  • 8c7b730 fix(installer): only show setup-token instructions on a first install
  • 3df9e81 test: allow background certificate issuance up to 60 s and print Caddy's log on failure; build: no embedded PDB setting for the WiX project
